key_points: Dividend raised to $0.63 quarterly, marking 16 consecutive years of increases.
CEO and insider sold shares (~$155k total), though likely routine under preset plans.
Class-action lawsuit alleges misleading 'sugar-free' labeling on protein drinks.
U.S. lawmaker pressuring Starbucks to close Xinjiang, China stores, adding geopolitical risk.
Positive turnaround narrative under Brian Niccol boosted short-term stock optimism.
